s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Battery Negative Terminal
Remove Rear Tire
Drain Differential Oil

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 10, remove the filler plug and gasket from the rear differential carrier.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10, remove the drain plug and gasket from the rear differential carrier, and drain the oil.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10, tighten the rear differential drain plug with a new gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Exhaust Tail Pipe Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.
Disconnect the 2 exhaust pipe supports and remove the exhaust tail pipe assembly.
Remove the gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Exhaust Pipe Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts.
Disconnect the 3 exhaust pipe supports and remove the exhaust center pipe assembly.
Remove the gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Floor Heat Insulator NO.2

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 nuts and remove the front floor heat insulator No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Propeller Shaft with Center Bearing Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and center bearing washers, and disconnect the propeller with center bearing shaft assembly.

item.ptxt: When removing, do not apply excessive force to the universal joints.
During removal, transport and storage, do not allow the No. 2 joint angle to be 20° or more.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the differential carrier assembly and propeller shaft assembly.
Remove the 4 nuts and 4 washers, and disconnect the propeller shaft assembly from the differential carrier assembly.
Put matchmarks on the transfer assembly and propeller shaft assembly.
Remove the 4 nuts and 4 washers, and disconnect the propeller shaft assembly from the transfer assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Set the SST aligned with the groove of the rear drive shaft assembly LH, and using a hammer, unstake the rear axle shaft nut.

item.ptxt: Set SST in the groove with its flat surface facing up.
Do not grind the tip of the SST with a grinder or equivalent.
When removing the rear axle shaft nut, completely unstake it.
Do not damage the threads of the drive shaft assembly.

s2.ptxt: Using a socket wrench (30mm), remove the rear axle shaft nut.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Shaft Nut RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Speed Sensor Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the clamp.
Remove the bolt and disconnect the speed sensor rear LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Speed Sensor Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Parking Brake Lever Protector

s2.ptxt: Remove the parking brake lever protector from the parking brake cable assembly No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the parking brake cable assembly NO.3 from the trailing arm assembly rear.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.2

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as the parking brake cable assembly No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the caliper with wire or equivalent.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Disc LH

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Disc RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and disconnect the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.
While lightly tapping the end of the rear drive shaft with a plastic hammer, remove the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.

atten4.ptxt: If the engagement is tight, tap the end of the drive shaft using a brass bar and hammer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Height Control Sensor Sub-assembly Rear (w/ Discharge Headlight)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector and disengage the clamp.
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the height control sensor assembly (rear).

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and disconnect the rear suspension arm assembly NO.1 LH from the rear suspension member assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 RH

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Trailing Arm Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Loosen the 2 bolts of the trailing arm assembly rear.

atten3.ptxt: Only loosen the bolts; do not remove them.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Trailing Arm Assembly Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 LH

s2.ptxt: Loosen the bolt and nut of the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.

item.ptxt: Only loosen the bolt and nut; do not remove them.
Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Carrier LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and disconnect the upper control arm assembly rear LH from the rear axle carrier.

item.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.
Suspend the rear drive shaft assembly LH with wire or equivalent.
Do not damage the drive shaft outboard joint boot.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolts and nuts, and remove the rear axle carrier from the trailing arm assembly rear and rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Carrier RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the front drive shaft assembly LH.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the oil seal.
Do not drop the drive shaft assembly.
Do not damage the speed sensor rotor.

atten4.ptxt: Hook the claws of the SST at the position (A) shown in the illustration on the rear drive shaft assembly LH, and remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Snap Ring LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, remove the snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Snap Ring RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Stabilizer Link Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut and remove the rear stabilizer cushion.
Remove the nut and remove the rear stabilizer link assembly LH.

atten4.ptxt: Hold the stud bolt using a socket hexagon wrench 6 so that it does not turn freely.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Stabilizer Link Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Shock Absorber Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Support the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH with a jack, with a block of wood in between.
Remove the bolt and nut, and disconnect the rear shock absorber assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Shock Absorber Assembly Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Member Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector, 4 clamps and hose.
Support the rear suspension member w/ differential carrier assembly with an engine lifter.

atten3.ptxt: The rear suspension member w/ differential is heavy, so support it securely with the engine lifter.

atten4.ptxt: Remove the rear suspension member together with the rear differential carrier assembly.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 4 nuts, and remove the rear suspension member w/ differential carrier assembly and 2 rear suspension member stoppers lower.

atten3.ptxt: Since the rear suspension member is removed together with the rear differential carrier assembly, perform the work with several people holding it so that the rear suspension member does not tilt significantly or fall.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Differential Carrier Assembly Rear

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts (A in the illustration) and disconnect the rear differential support assembly No.1 and rear differential support assembly No.2 from the rear differential carrier assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Remove the bolts while holding the differential carrier assembly.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts (B in the illustration) and 2 nuts, and remove the rear differential support assembly No.1 and rear differential support assembly No.2 from the rear suspension member.

atten3.ptxt: Remove the bolts while holding the differential carrier assembly.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt (C in the illustration) and remove the rear differential carrier assembly from the rear differential mount cushion No.1.

atten3.ptxt: Remove the bolts while holding the differential carrier assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Connector Clamp Bracket

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and remove the connector clamp bracket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Differential Support

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and remove the rear differential support.
